IC1: Patients with any contraindications [OR] or hypersensitivity [AND] related to antiplatelet therapy
IC2: Patients with Acute Myocardial Infarction (ST elevation myocardial infarction, [OR] Non ST elevation myocardial infarction)
IC3: Patients who are anticipated to receive treatment o [OR]r surgery t [AND]hat may require desisting the administration of antiplatelet therapy for 2 weeks or longer during the period of the clinical trial
IC4: Chronic total occlusion (C [OR]TO) lesions, in-stent restenosis (ISR)
IC6: Women who are breastfeeding, pregnant, or desiring pregnancy
IC8: Patients with a life expectancy of less than 1 year
IC9: Patients who have received a drug-eluting stent (DES) procedure within the past 6 months
IC10: Any other patients judged by the investigator to be unsuitable for the trial
